notes: Read by scripts/check-deps.ts (npm test). Units: first matching prefix wins; * takes that path segment. Every allow entry names the phase that removes it (DESIGN/xrplh-24 §6-7, xrplh-25 §4). A stale entry fails the check, so a removed coupling cannot come back unnoticed.

ignoreFiles.reason: holds import statements as fixture text inside strings

units.why: the root package (chainaim-router) is the gateway: its scripts and services/gateway are one unit
files at the root belong to the root package

forbid.why: a package must not depend on a service, an app or a tool
services talk over HTTP or the event log; shared code belongs in packages/
apps call services over HTTP; shared code belongs in packages/
tools take the module under test by flag, not by import

allow.reason: paywall scripts and tests use web's XRPL balance, payment and signer code
test fixtures use web's XRPL helpers
prompt-scan.ts uses the gateway's privacy detection

allow.until: owner decision: declared integration tests or a contract package

allowCycles.reason: client-mask lives in paywall, re-exported by web
